title: Not Even Big Sisters Are Perfect

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After an outing with Ines Fujin, I accompany her to the amusement park where she'll be working today.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, you're such a worrier! It's still bright out—you didn't have to come all the way here with me.
choice_data_list: Just think of it as the last stop of our trip.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. Well, thanks! Okay, time to scrub this place clean!

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text: Oh, Ines! You're here early! What a relief!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Heya-hey! What's got you in such a hurry?

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text: We're a little short-staffed today, so I made some last-minute changes to people's posts. Ines, you'll be on haunted house duty!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: H-haunted house duty?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin freezes up as a disturbed expression spreads across her face. I vaguely recall that she's not great with scary stuff…
choice_data_list: Are you going to be okay? Doesn't horror stuff scare—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: I-I'm just peachy! I can totally handle a haunted house!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Contrary to her claim, she looks anything but peachy. Unable to ignore my concerns, I step in…
choice_data_list: Excuse me, but I happen to be her trainer…
Excuse me, but I happen to be her trainer…

text_block_list.name: Shift Supervisor
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Having changed into work attire, Ines Fujin arrives at the haunted house looking disgruntled. The reason being…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, you worry way too much! I know my supervisor's fine with it and all, but asking to observe me on the job?
choice_data_list: Sorry, but I'm just worried about you.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Well, I guess four hands are better than two.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: The haunted house is closed right now because of some machine malfunctions. No one else has been assigned here, so you're helping me scrub this place down!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Since you're here, I'll teach you the art of cleaning! First, you start with the ceiling dust—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ka-thunk!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Eeek?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Wh-whoa, what gives? Oh, looks like I got my foot tangled in the vacuum cable… Ahaha…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Phew! I think that's most of it done. I'm feeling extra worn out today, though—huh?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ugh, someone's left their cleaning cloth under the sofa. Guess they forget to put it away. …Okay, got it.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fwip…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Fwip…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Lying underneath the sofa, hidden out of view, is a mummy puppet. Its eyes happen to meet Ines Fujin's and—

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Aaaargh?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Save me, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Good work today…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We somehow finish our cleaning duties, but Ines Fujin looks completely exhausted. I feel like I should break the silence…
choice_data_list: It's okay to admit when you can't handle something.
It's okay to admit when you can't handle something.
It was interesting seeing you react like that.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We somehow finish our cleaning duties, but Ines Fujin looks completely exhausted. I feel like I should break the silence…
choice_data_list: It's okay to admit when you can't handle something.
It's okay to admit when you can't handle something.
It was interesting seeing you react like that.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, maybe I was being a little stubborn…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Truth is, my supervisor's kind enough to adjust my shifts when I have training.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: That's why I was hoping to return the favor somehow…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: But if you hadn't been there, Trainer, I probably would've only caused my supervisor a headache.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …Yeah, you're right! I should ask for help when I need it. Okay, I'll show my gratitude with…

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: A good race! I think that suits me best!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I come away impressed by Ines Fujin's strong sense of duty—and by the way she somehow utilized today's events to fuel her passion for racing!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Oh, you thought that was entertaining, huh?! Hey now, it's not nice to tease people!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Sigh… I made a real spectacle of myself today, huh? I was so lame!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Trainer, could you keep what happened today between us? I'm really embarrassed about it…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I tell her that no matter how lame she might have seemed today, I won't tell a soul about it.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Hehe. You sure you can keep it secret? You might never see me mess up this bad again, you know?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: …But thanks!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Ines Fujin smiles softly. It looks like this experience has brought us even closer together!
